evidence.t: About 3 wetlands within 2 km (estimate): ducks move between them.
Beside Wedeene River: backwater or oxbow (estimate).
Elevation 185 m: under 900 m, open water later in fall.

seasonRows.notes: District 6. Within the 8 a day: 4 northern pintails, 4 canvasbacks, 2 Barrow's or common goldeneyes together, 2 harlequins. Possession 24: 12, 12, 6, 6.

plan: Drive: from City of Terrace, about 35 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate). Via Beam Station Rd, Beacon FSR, Westside Rd, Hwy 37.
Park: 54.22415, -128.68655, pull off on Wedeene FSR (gravel road). Map links below.
Walk: 7.4 km NW, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 143 m, about 163 min at 3 km/h.
Camp: flat ground 90 m NE of the spot at 186 m (54.25176, -128.77682). Water: Wedeene River 40 m W (estimate).
Hunt: ducks, Jan, Oct, Nov, Dec (season rows). Set up on the shore with the wind at your back: ducks land into the wind (Tip). Shoot only birds you can retrieve.
Use: 12 gauge, steel 2 to 4 (non toxic shot only), modified or improved cylinder rated for steel, plugged to 3 shells (regs).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 6-11, Region 6. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-01, closures 2026-10-16.
R6I-duck-backcountry-0003.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 6-11: about 917 hunter days a year for all big game (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.06 days per square km, bottom third of BC MUs; access: more than 5 km from a drivable road. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).
